I used to think my reels weren't good enough, but later I realised Instagram pushes reels that get more comments and shares.

After I started focusing on engagement instead of just posting, my reel reach, Instagram growth and follower growth started getting much better.

One thing that really helped was asking people to comment, replying automatically, and turning on the Follow Feature. It made the whole process much smoother.

Not saying this is magic, content still matters. But if your reels are stuck, focus on comments, shares and audience engagement first.
